title: OKC Thunder: From Seattle South
description: A relocation, a Brodie, a mountain of future assets, and a new face of the franchise—five steps into Thunder basketball.
imageHint: The electric blue and orange of Paycom Center with passionate fans creating one of the NBA's loudest atmospheres

questions.question: In what year did the Seattle SuperSonics relocate and become the Oklahoma City Thunder?
questions.explanation: Clay Bennett moved the club after a bitter arena fight in Seattle. Sam Presti, already GM, kept building through the shift.

questions.question: In that same 2008 draft, still under the Sonics name, Presti took which UCLA guard fourth overall?
questions.explanation: Durant was already there from 2007. Presti also grabbed Serge Ibaka at 24 that night. Westbrook became "The Brodie."

questions.question: Westbrook later averaged a triple-double for a full season—the first to do so since which legend?
questions.explanation: Robertson's 1961–62 season stood alone for 54 years until Westbrook matched it in 2016–17—and then did it again.

questions.question: After Westbrook left, which scoring guard became the new face of the Thunder?
questions.explanation: Acquired in the 2019 Paul George trade package. He became an MVP candidate while Presti restocked the cupboard.

questions.question: Around SGA, Presti is famous for stockpiling dozens of what future asset through trades?
questions.explanation: The Thunder turned stars into future firsts, then flipped those into more firsts. By the mid-2020s they held an absurd pile of upcoming selections.

easterEgg.title: Still Paycom
easterEgg.text: The arena downtown was Chesapeake Energy Arena until naming rights flipped to Paycom. The roar when the roof feels like it's shaking? Locals just call it loud.
